Alger, 30 août 2026 (Algeria Tech) — L’o: Algiers, August 30, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — The operator Djezzy has activated a solidarity initiative for residents in areas devastated by wildfires. Its customers will receive free calls, SMS, and mobile data.
L’opérateur de téléphonie mobile Djezzy: Mobile operator Djezzy has launched a humanitarian initiative targeting populations affected by recent wildfires, it announced in a press statement on Saturday. This action consists of offering free volumes of calls, SMS, and internet to customers located in the affected areas.
Les bénéficiaires recevront un SMS confi: Beneficiaries will receive an SMS confirming the activation of the benefits, the document specifies. This approach is part of the guidelines of the Ministry of Post and Telecommunications and aims to support government efforts in the face of this exceptional situation.
L’entreprise réaffirme son engagement à: The company reaffirms its commitment to mobilizing its resources to ensure the continuity of communications and contribute to the national resilience effort.
Parallèlement, le ministère de la Santé: Meanwhile, the Ministry of Health announced the mobilization of all human and material resources in the concerned hospital facilities. The objective is to ensure optimal and immediate care for the injured, particularly those evacuated to the Oran burn treatment hospital.
Quatorze personnes atteintes de brûlures: Fourteen burn victims were airlifted from the wilaya of Jijel to Oran, where they will receive specialized care. The families of the victims, evacuated to the Zéralda hospital, praised the total mobilization of institutions and the surge of popular solidarity.
